name: com.rootsbybenda/cosmetic-regulatory
description: Cosmetic ingredient safety and multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance. Check any ingredient against EU 1223/2009, US FDA, Korea MFDS, Japan MHLW, ASEAN, and 7 more jurisdictions. Pre-calculated Margin of Safety using SCCS methodology. 30,553 ingredients, 174,973 NOAEL studies, 99,535 MoS calculations. Free. Source-linked.

tools.name: check_ingredient
tools.description: Full cosmetic ingredient safety profile: SCCS opinion, 12-jurisdiction regulatory status, allergen, SVHC, IFRA, CIR conclusion, sensitization, NOAEL, dermal absorption, MoS.

tools.name: check_formula
tools.description: Batch compliance scan of up to 50 INCI ingredients. Per-ingredient regulatory status plus overall formula risk level and flagged ingredients.

tools.name: search_ingredients
tools.description: Discover cosmetic ingredients by partial name, function, or category. Returns up to 20 matches with safety scores and regulatory status.

tools.name: calculate_mos
tools.description: Calculate Margin of Safety using SCCS Notes of Guidance methodology. Provide ingredient, concentration, and product type — returns NOAEL, SED, MoS, and pass/fail assessment.
